Name: Shopkeepers buy more items
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[b][size=3]Introduction[/size][/b]
How it all started with just two shopkeepers...
[quote]Willy will now buy anything fish related and beach related! Ideal for especially early game, when the small backpack is a struggle... Imagine you forage on the beach before starting your fishing day, and everything you found, you can sell to Willy: coral, clam, sea urchin, but also anchor, dried starfish, and nautilus shell, and so on... Then you go fishing, and you fish up seaweed, sea jelly, and maybe some fish of course, and you can again sell your entire inventory to Willy! Less struggle early game!

Another shop that could fix some inventory struggle? Clint of course! You will now be able to sell all artifacts to Clint, so you can safely have him open a 100 artifact troves while selling in the meantime.[/quote]
Now, after [i]numerous [/i]updates, nearly all shopkeepers buy anything related to their profession, their area of expertise, their biomes, or any not far-fetched reason to buy your items. Sell beach forage to Willy, an artifact to Clint, grass starter to Pierre during a festival; the list goes on!

Another thing that's new in 1.1? Some shopkeepers only expand their buy-list after an event, quest or letter. Because mods need in-game explaining!

[b]Natural progression
[/b]
[list]
[*]To sell more to Willy: reach fishing and foraging level 2, then visit Willy's shop when he is there[/*]
[*]To sell more to Clint (only if Willy is enabled, otherwise no event needed): crack 15 geodes, witness Willy's event, then visit the Saloon when he is there[/*]
[*]To sell ginger items to Harvey: visit Ginger Island, a quest will come in the mail[/*]
[*]To sell more to Sandy: Sandy will send a mail when you reach 2 hearts[/*]
[/list]
[b][size=3]Options[/size][/b]
Can be installed anytime and will work immediately on the first in-game day!

There is the configuration option to turn off each of the shops' edits. There are three options grouped that sell the same: Dwarf and Volcanodwarf; Saloon and Island resort; and all Pierre's festival shops.

Turning the config back on will immediately add tags to the shop, but will need a restart to add the new custom tags to some miscellaneous items like pearls. Question, what are tags and miscellaneous items? Well, that information is moved to this new article: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4438]List of shops and tags[/url].

[size=3][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
Changes to Willy's shop tested with SVE and Eli & Dylan, so it is safe to assume that any mod that adds items properly with the right item tag will be added to the items Willy buys from you!

Changes to Clint's shop also tested with SVE. Works by the same item tag logic as Willy's shop. Just that the tag is tied to the item category.

Want more details? First, consult the new article [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4439]List of mod compatibility[/url] for a detailed list of which mods are likely compatible! Second, check out the other new article [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/articles/4438]List of shops and tags[/url] for an even more detailed list of the actual tags per shop.

[size=3][b]Compatibility notes for mod authors
[/b][/size]If you add one of the vanilla tags to your modded items, they will be sellable thanks to this mod. Check the articles to see what tags are sellable at what shop.

However, if you don't like any of the vanilla tags for your modded item(s) but want them sellable to any shop mentioned below, feel free to use the newly introduced tags, {{ModId}}_{{shopkeeper_name}}! In return, I wouldn't mind a thank you. :-)

If you introduce new item tags with your mod and want items sellable to a certain shop, feel free to look into my code, or reach out so I can add your tags in this mod.

[b][size=3]Roadmap[/size][/b]
If you have suggestions for another shop, or to add more item tags to one of these, let me know! Just keep it to QoL improvements and not too unrealistic. :-)

Untouched shops in no particular order:
[list]
[*]alex' ice cream stand[/*]
[*]traveling cart[/*]
[*]book seller[/*]
[*]joja mart[/*]
[*]hat mouse[/*]
[*]other festivals (many festivals use special currency like the calico desert festival or the stardew fair...)[/*]
[*]... and many other shops including ones that do not use coins as currency such as the desert trader[/*]
[/list]It is not my goal to add natural progression to every shop, as not everything needs explanation, but who knows what may come.

[b][size=3]Translations[/size][/b]
If you want to translate my mod:
[list]
[*]Ask permission first[/*]
[*]Credit me[/*]
[*]No standalone translated mod, only dependencies[/*]
[*]No AI[/*]
[/list]If you have translated another mod of me (like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/41060]Ginger Island events[/url]), you automatically have my permission to translate this or any other of my mods as well.

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Nothing. Big thanks to the wiki!
